manual_findings.finding: Host metadata is preserved, not file-authenticated; exact signature/finite names/rule syntax are checked. The whole supplied v2 registry is checked, including unreachable entries, complete full descriptor preimages, separately namespaced IDs, actual dependency census, cycles, ordered prior refs and named child outputs. No donor ID or hash-only authority.

Independent complete typed bindings cover TERM/FORMULA abstractions, VARIABLE roles and fixed-arity predicate symbols. Every template/argument/reference is reconstructed from one environment. Explicit all-port forward matching and repeated binding/source agreement are retained; inverse matching completeness is not asserted.

Finite deterministic fresh naming, lexical binder IDs, simultaneous substitution, alpha logs and explicit free-variable allowances follow the frozen wire relation. EIGEN includes complete original Gamma plus all root external input formulas. HOST_PROFILE_MEMBER is intentionally syntax/signature/name only, not current5d1 finite membership or rule validity.

Every root hypothesis becomes a real original indexed assumption node, including unused ones; nested hypothesis refs preserve actual Gamma provenance. Full topological primitive nodes/origins, ordered edges, nested call frames, all outputs and dependency-first descriptors are independently reconstructed. Root inputs are conditional dependencies with fact_accepted false even when occupied.

External source identity uses full provenance JSON and internal identity uses actual flattened node references through aliases. This correctly detects logical DISTINCT violations. Physical row/key aliasing is outside syntax checking and must be checked in the adapter; current adapter3 now enforces every frame at that boundary. The checker does not claim physical dedup, local t/m legality or scheduler authority.

The public endpoint makes its own builtin-only bounded copies, retains the full request including offered proposal, reconstructs substantive expansion without any producer/kernel/point call, and compares whole canonical bytes. Only producer-specific work is excluded from equality; its exact int bounds are checked and it remains explicitly untrusted. Structural costs are rebuilt, not copied as admission.

Only private own _Incomplete becomes UNKNOWN, with expansion None and conditional check false. Offered UNKNOWN must have empty partial arrays. External tick/native/resource errors propagate unchanged in the stated trusted synchronous callback scope; no absent family, exhausted candidate or theorem conclusion follows. Arbitrary hostile callbacks raising private checker exceptions are outside the declared scope.

No producer/host mathematical delegation or project imports exist; independent reconstruction is a separately authored implementation of the coordinated finite wire relation, not a new mathematical proof kernel. Receipt flags reject theorem/point/engine/pruning/RL/runtime acceptance. Root actual component controls and separate native host/whole marked point checks are still mandatory; all current engine13 adviceNone/baseline limits remain untouched.
